programmes.d: After a key witness and a U.S. marshal are ambushed and killed, Maggie and OA must find the man who leaked the information that led to their murders.
Maggie and OA hunt down a ruthless group of robbers who are posing as police officers to target armored trucks.
Maggie and OA lead the search for an abducted former biological weapons chemist.

When an alt-right provocateur is murdered after giving a speech at a university in New York City, Maggie and OA investigate the school's more extreme political groups and rely on OA's sister, a student, for help.

When a former member of the Irish Republican Army turned U.S. citizen is shot while in London with his son touring youth football academies, Smitty and the Fly Team work to hunt down the people responsible as the group becomes increasingly violent.

When the owner of a prominent cyber security company is murdered in Copenhagen, mass amounts of data are leaked, sending the NSA to the Fly Team for assistance, including the Bureau's liaison to the NSA.
The Fly Team heads to Oslo when they are tipped off that two Norwegian prisoners are being held in Russia, on the third season finale.
The Fly Team meets Supervisory Special Agent Wesley "Wes" Mitchell when his partner is shot in LA.

When a U.S. ambassador is taken hostage at a TV station in the Netherlands alongside 70 civilians, the Fly Team is forced to work quickly to find out who they're up against. Meanwhile, Wes works to earn the respect of his new team.

When an illegal arms broker turned informant is assassinated, OA assumes his identity and goes under cover to stop the sale of dangerous weapons, with help from Maggie and their former FBI instructor.
When a judge and her daughter are murdered after she sentences a man to life in prison, Maggie and OA search for the killer; Dana has a history with the victim and a vested interest in the case.
Maggie and OA must find a couple that is responsible for a spree of violent armed robberies that led to the death of an off-duty police officer.
After an investigative journalist is murdered, the team uncovers information linking the suspect to past cases

A serial bomber appears to be targeting Wall Street's elite; Maggie and OA search for a suspect who seems set on revenge; Dana deals with Spencer Briggs, a cocky profiler brought in to consult on the case.

When an American teenager disappears from a beach party during her senior year trip to Portugal, the Fly Team heads up the search, which is further complicated by the missing teen's parents' differing opinions.

The deputy inspector general calls on Tate, who is fluent in Spanish, to take on her first undercover field mission, joining Wes and the team in Spain as they investigate a seemingly dirty U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration special agent working out of
When an American man is kidnapped in Warsaw alongside a Ukrainian woman he met on a dating site, the Fly Team heads to Poland to track down the mastermind behind the site.
When a bus full of American volunteers is hijacked in a dangerous section of Morocco, the Fly Team works to locate the missing aid workers and the people who kidnapped them.

Wes' former colleague, U.S.-based agent Tyler Booth (guest star Jay Hayden), enlists the Fly Team's assistance in helping him capture an American on the FBI's "Most Wanted" list by luring him out of Russia with the help of the perp's conflicted ex-wife.
